# Process

## How do I get a quote?

Contact us by phone at (323) 645-2636 or email info@splendidmoving.com. Share your move details — origin, destination, preferred date, and number of bedrooms/amount of items. You'll receive a free, no-obligation quote. Long-distance moves may need a virtual or in-person consultation.

## How do I book my move?

Review and accept your quote, then pay a $50 deposit to secure your date. You'll get a confirmation email with your booking details.

## What happens on moving day?

The crew arrives at your scheduled time, the foreman collects your signature on a paper contract, and you do a walk-through to confirm inventory and special instructions. The team packs, wraps, and loads your items, transports them, unloads at the new location, and does a final walk-through to confirm everything's placed correctly.

## When do I pay the final balance?

Final payment is processed upon completion of the move, and you'll receive a paper copy of the contract.
